answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 69589 Country: India Title: Dua for promotion and prosperity in business Question: (1) Please give me application to start new business (2) What supplication to read promotion, blessing and prosperity in business. (3) Dua to read before starting business work in the morning. (4) Send supplication to protect business, business machines and work from evil eye, envious peoples and enemies. Answer ID: 69589 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 944/951/B=12/1437) Recite Surah Falaq and Surah Naas. Also recite Ayatul Kursi. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
